content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"Key evidence was never obtained or reviewed. The Threat Assessment Committee report and witness memos were never produced (CAPT deferred to HR, Acting HRM held them, and Acting HRM gave no statement). LT2's photos of Complainant's neck were not located, and CAPT could not recall them. CO1's contemporaneous memo is mentioned but not shown. The statements of CO1, CO2, LT1 and LT2 came only in a supplemental report. Complainant's medical documentation and CO2's alleged remarks were not tested. On Claim 2, the decision-makers on the AWOL coding and welfare check, and any CAPT statement about Complainant being psychologically unstable, were not addressed in any detail. The agency's Claim 1 rationale (no prompt report of the slurs) is not an adequate basis because it ignores that the record has conflicting accounts and an unexamined physical-assault corroboration trail. The record cannot support a reliable merits decision until these gaps are filled."}
